name: Bar Room Bash
description: A meet gone wrong in a crowded dive bar. Tables are flipped, bottles are flying, and the local gangers are looking for a fight.
scenario_rules: Bar Brawl: Lots of improvised weapons and collateral damage. Movement is restricted by broken furniture and panicked patrons.
